My dear [Miss Sewell](../persons.html#1301),
I shall be very glad to see you on the 2nd and hope we shall do a great deal of business together[^2]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.

[^2]: CMY had written to Macmillan on September 30th: \'I believe the [second part](../books.html#82) of Historical Selections is almost ready.\'
